title: Review High-Risk Obligation Content
decisionRule: High-risk or expert-review-required obligations may appear in customer-facing production views only when review_state is published and required source/review metadata is complete. Approved records that are not published remain withheld from customer-facing views until a separate publication decision is recorded.

records.rationale: Procurement-integrity and antitrust guidance can create legal-risk interpretations; source metadata is present, but expert approval is still required before publication.
Published record includes source URL, trigger condition, required actions, evidence examples, confidence, review owner, review state, and last-reviewed date.
Published record includes source URL, trigger condition, required actions, evidence examples, confidence, review owner, review state, and last-reviewed date.
Cyber incident reporting and covered defense information obligations require SME/legal review before customer-facing publication.
NIST SP 800-171 assessment notice guidance requires SME review before customer-facing publication.
Assessment access, flow-down, and DoD assessment obligations require SME review before customer-facing publication.
CMMC contractual requirement guidance is high-impact and must remain hidden until SME/legal review approves publication.
Expert review approval is recorded, but the record is not in the published state and remains withheld from customer-facing production views.
Expert review approval is recorded, but labor standards guidance is not in the published state and remains withheld from customer-facing production views.

blockers.mitigation: Keep needs_review and approved-but-unpublished high-risk obligations hidden from customer-facing production views until explicit publication approval is recorded.
